source: ArabicOCR_KHATT (MIT) fine-tuned 500 steps on CPU (first conv layers frozen) with 81 Yemeni handwritten lines read by Claude from the user's photos, plus KHATT, Muharaf and synthetic legal lines. ONNX: constant zone bounds, LSTM int8, conv weights fp16 cast at load. CER with beam+LM (held-out): Yemeni 9 lines 54.4% -> 41.5%, KHATT 100 lines 12.0% -> 12.7%, Muharaf 100 lines 41.2% -> 37.4%.
